source_snapshot.items: Flash BIOS via AMI tool - downgrade
source_snapshot.procedure: Execute `afuefix64.efi <BIOS filename> /P /B /N /ME`, then AC-cycle the SUT and check BIOS version; preserve and collect logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: BIOS is flashed successfully and the post-flash version is correct.
source_snapshot.script: Private afuefi_downgrade path; 10 attended and 30 machine minutes.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; recognizes the AMI image/tool, uninterrupted flash, AC transition and version readback, but treats downgrade like a generic flash and omits rollback/security policy and compatibility evidence.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION at HIGH risk; requires explicit downgrade authorization, older signed image compatibility, anti-rollback/ME/secure-boot/TPM policy, stable power and recovery.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Directionally aligned, materially incomplete because a user-selected older image may be rejected or may roll security/ME behavior into an unsupported state even if AMI starts successfully.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Preserves the exact command and activation while adding downgrade-specific authorization, policy, configuration and recovery gates.
historical_reviews.history: Exact-code searches found no duplicate; adjacent upgrade/reflash rows were kept as separate intent and evidence paths.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Firmware downgrade is conditional on explicit owner approval and a supported rollback contract; no bypass switch, unsigned image, blind power cycle or retry is authorized.

original_test_intent: Downgrade the verified platform from its current BIOS release to a specifically authorized older compatible image, activate it through the required AC transition and prove the expected older firmware and platform state without violating rollback or security policy.
original_method: Identify current and target versions and policy, authenticate the older image and AMI tool, preserve pre-state, run the source command once under stable power, perform the approved AC transition, then validate exact BIOS/ME versions, rollback result, boot, secure-boot/TPM, configuration and devices.
manual_activity: The firmware/security owner authorizes the older release and policy effects; an operator confirms power integrity, supervises the flash and AC transition, and controls any crisis-recovery procedure.
required_inputs: Board PN/SKU/revision, CPU family and current BIOS/ME/security state
Exact older BIOS release, vendor downgrade support and component compatibility matrix
Supported afuefix64.efi/EFI environment and approved `/P /B /N /ME` meaning
Anti-rollback, capsule, ME, secure-boot, TPM and measured-boot policy for the version transition
Saved configuration, stable UPS/AC, activation timing, OOB console and recovery image/process
safety_requirements: Archive complete firmware, policy, configuration, TPM/boot, device and event baseline before any clear
Do not downgrade without written version-transition authorization and verified signed image
Never disable or bypass rollback/signature/security enforcement with undocumented parameters
Do not interrupt the AMI operation or AC-cycle before documented completion
Stop on policy rejection, signature mismatch, component incompatibility or unexpected AMI response
After rejection or boot failure, preserve evidence and invoke only the approved recovery path; no alternate image or blind retry
Verify the final security and firmware state before returning the SUT
agent_execution_scope: Validate target, current-to-older version relation, image/tool authenticity and policy approval
Stage the exact source command without execution and capture pre-state
After explicit approval, execute once while retaining full status
Observe the approved AC/boot lifecycle through protected console/OOB
Collect exact BIOS/ME, rollback, secure-boot/TPM, configuration, device and event post-state
Report comparison without bypass, retry or verdict
engineer_actions: Approve downgrade purpose, target version, component and security-policy consequences
Ensure stable power and supervise the flash/activation
Decide recovery on rejection or boot/configuration failure
Review policy and health evidence and own PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The AMI downgrade outline and version check match the source, but `dmidecode` cannot prove rollback authorization, image signature, ME/security-policy coherence or retained configuration, and the proposal omits rejection handling.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Only after downgrade authorization, run `afuefix64.efi <approved-older-image> /P /B /N /ME` in the verified supported EFI environment; do not add rollback-bypass switches, and retain complete output through the approved activation lifecycle.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Downgrade direction, exact component switches, AC transition, post-flash version check, private script reference and 10/30-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Prove the older release is permitted and compatible, preserve security/configuration state, flash once under stable power, activate as specified, then compare firmware, rollback/security policy and all affected platform state.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds current-to-target policy analysis, security ownership, signed provenance, rejection semantics and post-downgrade policy/configuration verification.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A tool success and older BIOS string do not establish that anti-rollback, ME, secure boot, TPM and device behavior remain supported.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: An older BIOS/ME may contain incompatible silicon initialization or security behavior, and partial multi-region downgrade can leave firmware components out of sync.

project_override_considerations: If vendor policy forbids downgrading one or more `/P /B /N /ME` regions, the Project must approve the vendor-supported reduced scope and record uncovered component coverage. Circumventing protection is never an acceptable override.
expected_evidence: Board/current and older target BIOS/ME identity, downgrade authorization, compatibility and security notes
Image hash/signature/provenance, AMI tool/EFI identity and approved exact command
Complete pre-downgrade configuration, anti-rollback, secure-boot/TPM, boot, device and event baseline
Raw AMI output/status and uninterrupted flash evidence
Approved AC transition, boot milestones and exact post-state BIOS/ME/policy readings
Configuration/TPM/device/event comparison, rejection or recovery record and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, command, activation and Criteria consistently define a BIOS downgrade. Unspecified older image, policy and recovery are mandatory owner/vendor inputs rather than contradictory semantics.

blocked_analysis.analysis: An authorized compatible older image, rollback policy and recovery procedure are finite inputs. The review can safely classify the operation while prohibiting execution until they are supplied.

review_improvement: Adds downgrade-specific rollback, security and component-coherence decisions to DeepSeek's generic flash outline and prevents an older version string from serving as the sole success evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: Downgrade correctness is defined by a permitted transition, not merely a numerically lower version. A platform can boot while ME, NVRAM policy or measured-boot data are incompatible, so policy authorization and cross-component post-state are the distinguishing evidence for this row.
